title: A Study to Assess the Efficacy, Safety, and what the body does to RO7837195 in Participants with Moderately to Severely Active Ulcerative Colitis
official: A Phase IIb, Multicenter, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Induction Study with an Active Treatment Extension to Assess the Efficacy, Safety, and Pharmacokinetics of RO7837195 in Patients with Moderately to Severely Active Ulcerative Colitis
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the efficacy of RO7837195 compared with placebo in inducing remission
conditions: Moderately to Severely Active Ulcerative Colitis (UC)
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Diagnosis of UC established at least 3 months prior to screening, confirmed by clinical and endoscopic evidence during screening
2. Evidence of UC extending a minimum of 15 cm from the anal verge as determined by baseline endoscopy (flexible sigmoidoscopy or colonoscopy) performed during screening
3. Colonoscopy within 2 years prior to screening or willingness to undergo colonoscopy in lieu of a flexible sigmoidoscopy at screening
4. Moderately to severely active UC, defined as a modified Mayo Score (mMS) of 5-9 including an endoscopic subscore of ≥ 2 during the screening period
5. Agreement to adhere to the contraception requirements
6. Prior advanced therapy failure and/or conventional therapy failure
Exclusion criteria:
1. Pregnant or breastfeeding, or intending to become pregnant during the study or within the timeframe in which contraception is required
2. Prior extensive colonic resection, subtotal or total colectomy, or planned surgery for UC
3. History of or current ileostomy or colostomy
4. Diagnosis of Crohn’s disease or indeterminate colitis
5. Suspicion of ischemic colitis, radiation colitis, or microscopic colitis
6. Diagnosis of toxic megacolon within 12 months prior to screening
